journals.name: 00 — START HERE: THE LAST TWO SESSIONS
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/00 — Command Centre

pages.name: Exact Handoff — Nov 8
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Start here — do not replay completed material

The module now begins at the precise session cutoff.

Location: hidden summoning chamber beneath Wachter House, Vallaki.

Time: late evening, shortly after the party infiltrated Vallaki around 10 PM.

Immediate situation: Lady Wachter and her sons Karl and Nikolai are dead; their bodies are hidden in Damien's portable hole. Finn escaped in bat form. The resurrected servant was paid 32 pp and sent toward the Abbey. The party found shredded black-wax documents bearing Strahd's crest and then found Arl in the summoning circle.

The actual cliffhanger: Arl's terms have been accepted, but the contract has not yet been written/signed and he has not been released.
☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: Continuity That Is Already True
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Do not accidentally reset these choices

  • Strahd’s invitation letter is still sealed/unopened.
  • The party planned to take it to Van Richten.
  • Saraphene already delivered Ravenloft intelligence and departed.
  • Tatyana answered the Sending: Ravenloft is watching; Strahd is afraid; she is “sometimes” herself and sounded more like frightened Ireena.
  • The party created nine flasks of holy water total: three each from Damien, Vesper and Legna.
  • Thorgrinn’s mechanical arm has been adapted to use silver shot.
  • Legna has Thorgrinn’s potion of fire giant strength.
  • Bunch has the Cloak of the Bat and Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals available among her equipment.
  • Azrathox is not inside Vallaki. He agreed to meet them after they leave the city.
  • Thorgrinn has Baldrik’s unopened family-crested keepsake box with the star-shaped lock.
  • Madam Eva’s final five prophecies have already been spoken.
☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: Run Order — From Here to Campaign End
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The complete finale path

  1. Sign & free Arl. 10–20 min.
  2. Reach Van Richten. Use Vallaki civil-war visuals, not a mandatory street combat. 10–20 min.
  3. Open Strahd’s letter at the workshop. 10 min.
  4. Van Richten’s final briefing & supplies. 30–45 min.
  5. One optional Vallaki intervention. 0–30 min.
  6. Exit Vallaki and reunite with Azrathox. 10 min.
  7. Approach Ravenloft / War of Broken Gods begins. 30–60 min.
  8. Brides / Abbot / Finn / Tatyana. 2–3 hours.
  9. Strahd mythic phases + Dark Power crisis + Wish. 3–5 hours.
  10. Coffin, Barovia collapse, prophecy/arc resolution, Ironfist transition. 30–60 min.

The intended split is after Finn/Tatyana or at Strahd’s first physical appearance.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: What “Finish the Campaign” Means
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Five end conditions

  1. Strahd reaches a permanent death and his coffin cannot restore him.
  2. Neither Orcus nor Vampyr inherits Barovia through Strahd’s ending.
  3. The Wish/Edict of Finality makes at least the active Dark Power manifestations genuinely finishable in Barovia.
  4. The five Tarokka prophecies receive opportunities to become true through player choice—not forced outcomes.
  5. The final Vecna/Orcus/Vampyr Attention totals and player choices determine the supernatural shadow over the next arc while the physical exit still points toward Thorgrinn’s family.
☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 01 — BLACK SUN & RAVENLOFT RULES
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Veil of the Black Sun
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The sunlight rule

Strahd, his brides and Finn possess the Veil of the Black Sun.

Ordinary sunlight does not harm them. Daylight does not trigger their sunlight weakness. Normal radiant damage still works normally.

Artifact sunlight penetrates the Veil. A protected vampire beginning its turn in artifact sunlight takes 15 radiant damage, cannot regenerate, cannot enter mist-form escape, and cannot use Ravenloft wall-phasing until the beginning of its next turn.

Dispel Magic: DC 18 spellcasting ability check. Success suppresses the Veil until the beginning of the caster's next turn.

The Sunsword and the strongest anti-vampire manifestations of the Holy Symbol qualify. A similarly potent sacred artifact can qualify at GM discretion.

This is meant to reward the campaign artifacts rather than make them irrelevant.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: Bride mist rule
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Defeating a bride

When a bride reaches 0 HP, the Veil tries to turn them into mist.

The party has until the end of the next round to expose the fallen bride to artifact sunlight or another powerful anti-vampire effect.

  • Success: the bride is destroyed.
  • Failure: they escape into Ravenloft and may return as a complication in Strahd Phase II with about 40 HP.

This teaches the same finality rule the party will need against Strahd.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 02 — THE LAST ROAD: VALLAKI TO RAVENLOFT
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: 1 — Leave Vallaki
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The city behind them

If the party chose a Vallaki intervention, resolve its consequence before they cross the gate. Otherwise do not invent a pursuit simply to delay Ravenloft.

The gate closes behind you. For a few steps the chanting is still audible. Then the trees swallow Vallaki and the road becomes only mud, moonlight and the sound of five people who have run out of reasons to turn back.
☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: 2 — Azrathox Returns
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Rendezvous

Something enormous moves above the treeline. Red scales catch moonlight. Azrathox lands hard enough to send wet leaves spiralling across the road.

He looks at each of you, then toward Vallaki.

“You did not ask me to massacre it.”

A pause.

“I am learning this may be considered progress.”
☾ ◆ ☽

Bunch’s relationship with the dragon matters. He is no longer merely hired transport, but he still wants his share of Ravenloft’s treasure.

pages.name: 3 — Thorgrinn’s Unopened Box
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Ironfist foreshadowing that is actually established

Do not add another Baldrik letter. Thorgrinn already received the stronger object: the unopened keepsake box.

During flight, a hard impact or magical disturbance causes the box to shift in Thorgrinn’s haversack. He recognizes the star-shaped lock and remembers making this style with Baldrik as children.

No key appears. The box stays closed. The important feeling is that Baldrik expected something of Thorgrinn’s future strongly enough to leave this behind, even after seeing him dead.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: 4 — The Prisoners Reach the Castle First
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Trigger the War of Broken Gods

Ravenloft appears through the storm—and the mountain below it moves.

Two immense horns break the grave-soil beneath the castle as green corpse-light begins climbing toward the walls.

At the same moment every high window bleeds upward. The blood gathers above the towers into a red-black wound in the sky.

Far ahead, an infernal flare answers from the castle approach. Arl has reached Ravenloft.

Then the bells of the castle begin to ring.

Not for you.

For them.
☾ ◆ ☽

Move directly into 03A — The War of Broken Gods. Arl defaults toward Orcus. The players decide where Azrathox goes.

journals.name: 03 — THE CASTLE OPENS ITS MOUTH
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Azrathox and the Storm
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The approach

Azrathox carries the Unkindness toward Ravenloft. Lightning reveals the castle by design: Strahd wants his entrance framed properly.

Halfway across the valley, Strahd's voice comes from the thunder:

“You brought me a dragon.”

“That is new.”

The line matters: even Strahd has not seen this exact version of events.

Ancient castle wards prevent Azrathox from entering the interior. Do not make the dragon irrelevant; gargoyles and enormous bat swarms tear free of the towers and Azrathox fights them above the castle while the party enters. Periodically let the party hear impacts through the ceiling.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: The Unattended Dinner
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The front door is unlocked

A dining table is set for five. Five glasses. Five chairs. A sixth chair at the head is turned backwards.

On Thorgrinn's plate is a small piece of dwarven mail or correspondence already opened by Strahd. It contains a simple line from home:

“Baldrik says there may be roads where ordinary roads end. If you find him, both of you come home.”

Strahd has written underneath:

He found you. One of you simply failed to return.

The doors close. The organ begins. The gauntlet starts.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 04 — STRAHD AS THE INVISIBLE LAIR BOSS
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Castle Actions
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Initiative 20 during the bride gauntlet

Strahd is not physically present. His voice comes from portraits, mirrors, fireplaces, statues, corpses, the organ, or directly through a bride.

Choose one Castle Action at initiative 20:

The House Moves. A 20-foot section of floor/wall/stair shifts. Creatures there make DC 17 Dexterity saves or are moved up to 15 feet to spaces Strahd chooses.

The Curtains Reach. One creature makes DC 17 Strength or Dexterity save or is Restrained by living shadow until it uses an action to escape.

Blackout. Mundane and non-artifact magical light is extinguished. Artifact sunlight remains. Strahd: “There. Much better.”

The Master's Courtesy. One bride moves up to half speed without provoking and may end one Grappled or Restrained condition on themselves.

The Organ Plays. DC 17 Constitution save; 14 thunder + 14 psychic and pushed 10 feet on failure; half damage and no push on success.

A Word in the Ear. DC 17 Wisdom save; on failure disadvantage on the target's next attack roll or saving throw. Once a character succeeds against this action, they become immune to it.

Use separation, movement and humiliation more often than raw damage.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: How Strahd Speaks
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Performance rule

As long as Strahd calls them the Unkindness, he believes he owns the story.

During the brides he is conversational and quiet. During Phase I he is entertained. Phase II is when he starts using individual names. Phase III contains no collective nickname at all.

General lines:

“There you are. I was beginning to think you had mistaken surviving for arriving.”
“An Unkindness of ravens. You circle death so faithfully. One would almost think you worship it.”
“I invited you to dinner. You burned my invitation. I invited you to a wedding. At least your manners have improved.”
“You have killed me before. That is the amusing part. Usually you don't remember.”
“The book told you? How terribly rude. I had grown rather fond of watching you discover it again.”

For Thorgrinn:

“Your brother mourned you.”

Later:

“What will he call you when he sees you again, I wonder? Brother? Machine? Miracle?”

And, when he realizes Thorgrinn received something from Baldrik:

“Your brother left you a box. He expected you to understand the lock.”
☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 05 — MOVEMENT I: ANASTRASYA & VOLENTA
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The Ballroom
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The Ballroom

The ballroom lights ignite. Anastrasya is already dancing alone.

Volenta is not on the ceiling. He stands at the far end of the room in blackened plate, a cracked bridal mask fixed over part of his face, his sword point resting on the floor as though he has been waiting through an entire ceremony for the Unkindness to arrive.

Strahd says:

“You have met some members of my household.”

“Ana has met all of you.”

“Volenta prefers longer courtships.”

Anastrasya manipulates movement, sight lines and attention. Volenta is the male Oathbreaker bride Madam Eva described: patient, martial and predatory. He does not frenzy. He selects the character who becomes isolated and turns the ballroom into a duel they did not agree to fight.

Environmental beats

  • Round 2 — The First Dance Ends: chandeliers fall. DC 16 Dexterity save, 3d10 bludgeoning on failure, half on success; fallen chandeliers create difficult terrain. Volenta uses the new lanes to cut one character away from the others.
  • Round 3 — Processional: the walls rotate, narrowing and lengthening the ballroom. Anastrasya may move one willing allied vampire 15 feet as part of the change. Volenta should use Broken Vow Aura to deny reactions while crossing the new lane.
  • Round 4 — The Groom in Every Mirror: every mirror shows Strahd behind one character. An attack against the correct mirror destroys it and cancels Strahd's next Castle Action. Volenta immediately marks whoever attacks the wrong mirror with Months, Not Minutes.

How Volenta Fights

Volenta opens with Dreadful Aspect if he can catch at least three characters. He then uses Black Oath Blade and holds Sanguine Smite for a target who is frightened, isolated or already committed to protecting someone else. He should feel like an Oathbreaker paladin who has had centuries to learn patience, not a generic vampire bruiser.

If Anastrasya is threatened, Unholy Intercession lets him cross the floor and punish the attacker. If Volenta is exposed to artifact sunlight, his poise finally cracks.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 06 — MOVEMENT II: LUDMILLA
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The Laboratory of Night
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Setup

The chamber is arranged like someone has spent months learning how to kill the party.

There are diagrams of mechanical Thorgrinn, Raven Queen feathers, the Holy Symbol, Finn's reaction to Daylight, and the Sunsword.

Strahd says:

“Ludmilla believes preparation defeats chaos.”

“You may demonstrate the flaw in her hypothesis.”

Three Nightglass Pylons surround the room. While at least two remain, Ludmilla resists non-artifact radiant damage. Artifact sunlight always cuts through.

Her notes reveal the rule explicitly:

It does not overpower the veil. It declares the veil irrelevant.

That sentence gives the players confidence that the artifacts they earned matter.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 07 — THE ABBOT AT THE ALTAR
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The Wedding Officiant
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Do not default to another boss fight

The Abbot is preparing the altar. He still believes some version of the wedding may end Barovia's suffering because Strahd has given him one more promise to rationalize.

Run a social challenge: 3 successes before 2 failures, DC 16.

Valid approaches include Religion, Insight, Persuasion, presenting Strahd's betrayals, and confronting him with the death of Anya/Vasilka. Good player-created approaches should count.

Success: he finally realizes Strahd wanted to watch him keep trying. He leaves the altar after one healing miracle: every member of the Unkindness regains 20 HP and may end one disease, curse, or condition currently affecting them.

Failure without violence: he blesses Finn with 30 temporary HP and withdraws.

If attacked: use the Abbot actor, but do not force him to fight to the death.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 08 — FINN: THE LAST DOOR
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The Sanguine Son
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The chapel

Finn waits alone. No spawn, no bride, no disposable minions. Strahd wants this choice to belong to the Unkindness.

Finn is dressed for the wedding court and looks healthier than he ever did alive.

Strahd says:

“You wanted him back.”

“I merely listened.”

Finn smiles:

“Don't make this weird.”

Then combat begins.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: The Three Chains of Claim
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Saving Finn

Finn has three Chains of Claim. They are emotional/metaphysical restraints, not targetable objects.

The Sanguine Moon. Strahd gave Finn his body back. Challenge the belief that resurrection creates ownership.

The Rejected Self. Finn insists his old self is gone. Show that transformation does not erase identity. Thorgrinn is an obvious counterexample.

The Master's Gift. Finn believes Strahd made him stronger. Show that usefulness is not the same as being valued.

Breaking a chain normally requires an action and a meaningful DC 16 Persuasion, Insight, Religion, or other justified check. A powerful campaign callback may simply work.

Excellent callbacks include Waterdeep, Justin, Finn's old companions, his death, Madam Eva's quick-hand/careful-hand warning, and his fear of rats.

When all three chains break, Finn stops fighting. He looks toward Strahd's voice:

“You knew.”

Strahd answers:

“Of course.”

If Finn turns, once per Strahd phase he may cancel one Ravenloft Lair Action.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: The Rat Beat
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Halfway through the fight

Strahd releases rats into the chapel solely to humiliate Finn.

Finn freezes for a fraction of a second.

The old fear is still there.

If the players respond emotionally rather than treating this merely as a mechanical vulnerability, grant advantage on the next attempt to break a Chain.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 09 — IREENA / TATYANA
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Her choice
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Not another bride stat block

Ireena/Tatyana appears after Finn's resolution. She is pale, vampiric, Tatyana-aware, familiar and sad.

If someone says “We came to save you,” she hardens.

If someone says “We failed you,” she listens.

If someone says “You don't belong to him,” she looks toward the dark where Strahd has been speaking.

Her central line:

“You still think this is about getting me out.”

“It is about whether he is allowed to keep choosing for everyone.”

Then the chapel doors open.

Strahd is standing immediately behind the party.

“At last.”

He looks at the bodies, Finn, Tatyana and the Unkindness.

“Well.”

“This has become inconvenient.”

This is the ideal end of Session One.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 10 — STRAHD’S COURTESY
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The short rest
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

An absurd offer

Strahd offers the party a genuine short rest:

“You have travelled a considerable distance.”

“Drink. Bind your wounds. Pray if you still find it comforting.”

“I have waited centuries.”

“An hour will not inconvenience me.”

If accepted: allow a genuine Short Rest. Strahd begins Phase I with 30 temporary HP because he also prepared.

If refused: Strahd receives no temporary HP and cannot use a Lair Action during round one.

Both choices are valid.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 11 — STRAHD PHASE I: THE COUNT WHO KNOWS YOU
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Run the phase
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Elegant Strahd

Use Strahd — Phase I.

He is still playing. He walks when he could run. He uses movement, charm, walls and reach to force the party to waste actions finding him.

Shared across all phases:

  • Save DC 18.
  • Attack +10/+11.
  • Four Legendary Resistances total across the confrontation.
  • At each phase transition he regains one expended Legendary Resistance, up to four.
  • Castle Step fails under artifact sunlight.

Phase I lair ideas

  • Rotate a staircase.
  • Create a door where there was none.
  • A character's shadow attacks for 3d8 necrotic.
  • A portrait becomes a portal.
  • Tilt the floor and move creatures 20 feet.

At 0 HP

Strahd looks surprised, then smiles:

“Oh.”

“So it is this version.”

He explodes into bats. The Heart begins beating through the stone. Start Phase II.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 12 — STRAHD PHASE II: THE LORD IS THE CASTLE
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Heart of Ravenloft
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Objective phase

Use Strahd — Phase II plus three Heart Chain actors.

The battlefield should be vertical: staircases, balconies, the Heart, black fog.

Three chains connect Strahd to Ravenloft:

Blood: 35 HP, AC 17. Destroying it deals 20 irresistible radiant/force to Strahd and reduces Phase II regeneration from 20 to 10. Phase III gets no regeneration from this chain.

Stone: 35 HP, AC 17. Destroying it deals 20 damage and removes Castle Step for the rest of the fight.

Dominion: 35 HP, AC 17. Destroying it deals 20 damage and removes one Legendary Action per round.

The party may ignore the chains and focus Strahd. The chains are advantages, not mandatory puzzle keys.

Eternal Night

Ordinary magical light cannot illuminate the chamber. Artifact sunlight cuts visible corridors through the darkness.

The mask slips

At roughly half HP, Strahd stops saying “the Unkindness” and addresses individual characters by name.

For Thorgrinn:

“Your brother opened a road into my country.”

“Perhaps he will be the one who leads you out.”

At 0 HP the Heart ruptures, the floor collapses, and Phase III begins in the catacombs.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 13 — STRAHD PHASE III: THE DEVIL WITHOUT THE MASK
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: The frightened predator
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

No more courtliness

Use Strahd — Phase III.

His jaw distends, shadow mismatches his body, and movement becomes animalistic. No Charm. No theatrical patience.

This is the first phase in which he willingly attacks a fallen character.

Tatyana's choice

At approximately half HP, Strahd orders Tatyana to come to him.

If the party treated her entirely as a helpless object to recover, she rejects both sides and leaves.

If they respected her agency, she says:

“No.”

Remove one remaining Legendary Resistance from Strahd and reveal the coffin's location. Set Coffin Distance to 4 instead of 5.

If Finn was saved, his presence makes Strahd's loss of control even more visible.

Voice progression

Bloodied:

“I brought you here.”

Later:

“I made this possible.”

Then:

“You are nothing without this place!”

If they remind him they destroyed the Amber powers:

“I know.”

That is the first time his voice should sound afraid.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 14 — THE COFFIN CHASE & PERMANENT DEATH
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: Five-round chase
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Crimson mist

When Phase III reaches 0 HP, Strahd becomes crimson mist racing toward his coffin.

Start at Distance 5. If Tatyana revealed the location, start at Distance 4.

Each round every character may use movement and one action to overcome an obstacle or reduce Distance.

Examples:

  • Athletics smashes through a closing route.
  • Acrobatics crosses broken stairs.
  • Arcana interferes with the mist's supernatural movement.
  • Religion follows the vampiric bond.
  • Perception/Investigation uses the Tome.
  • A spell that genuinely bypasses an obstacle simply works.

A successful contribution reduces Distance by 1. An exceptional solution may reduce it by 2. A serious failure can increase it by 1.

If Finn survived, once during the chase he can say “This way.” Reduce Distance by 1.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: The last anchor
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Strahd's coffin

AC 17, 50 HP, resistance to nonmagical damage.

Artifact sunlight touching the coffin suppresses all vampire regeneration.

Once the party reaches it, they have three rounds before Strahd reforms.

If the coffin is destroyed first, the mist is forced to materialize. Strahd returns with about 60 HP, no Legendary Resistances, no regeneration, and no castle phasing. This is not a fourth full phase; let the players execute the vampire.

If he reforms before the coffin breaks, he returns at about 80 HP and fights until the anchor is destroyed. Do not reset the entire encounter.

Permanent death

When the coffin is gone and Strahd reaches 0 again, the Amber cycle fails to catch him.

He looks upward, waiting for the old return.

Nothing answers.

Then:

“What did you do?”

Let a player answer.

Then he dies.

☾ ◆ ☽

journals.name: 15 — BAROVIA DIES / IRONFIST BEGINS
journals.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/01 — Finale Journals

pages.name: 1 — The Domain Collapses
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

No victory lap inside Ravenloft

When Strahd dies permanently and no Dark Power inherits the ending, Barovia begins losing the structure that held it apart from the wider planes.

Every flame goes out.

The moon disappears.

For one impossible second there is no wind anywhere in Barovia.

Then Ravenloft begins turning into mist from the highest tower downward.
☾ ◆ ☽

Outsiders are ejected rather than erased. Trapped souls can finally rejoin the natural cycle.

pages.name: 2 — Resolve the Cosmic Shadow
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Before the Mists take them

Read the Vecna / Orcus / Vampyr Attention totals and the final disposition of each manifested power. This determines the supernatural thread that survives Barovia.

A tie is allowed. Do not force a single villain if the party repeatedly courted two.

☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: 3 — The Keepsake Box Reacts
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

The real Baldrik bridge

As the Mists lose their old borders, Thorgrinn’s family-crested keepsake box becomes unexpectedly heavy in his hands. The star-shaped keyhole catches a spark of pale light.

This does not mean the box was secretly a teleportation device. It means the collapsing Mists are searching for a surviving connection outside Barovia, and Baldrik’s recent Vistani route plus the object he left for Thorgrinn provide one.

For an instant Thorgrinn smells hot iron, coal smoke and wet mountain stone.

Not Barovia.

Home.
☾ ◆ ☽

pages.name: 4 — The First Sound Is an Anvil
pages.html:
☾ ◆ ☽

Transition to The Shield Between Us

Three strikes.

Pause.

Two strikes.

Cold air. Pine. Rain. Coal smoke. Real weather.

The white mist tears apart around you.

For the first time in what feels like forever, the darkness above you is only night.

There are stars.

Beneath your feet is a flawlessly engineered stone road.

Fifty yards away stands a squat fortress built directly into the mountainside.

Above it, snapping in the wind, hangs a white banner.

A closed fist grips an iron nail.
☾ ◆ ☽

The Shield Between Us begins.
